See RUNBOOK.md section 2 and SEAL-V2-2026-11-16.md.
seal_status: Audit of all 21 event streams: 745 tool events, 45 raw audit flags — every one a davinci-resolve*/resolve_control name recorded in tuple form by the errored-call branch (audit-stringification artifact, fixed driver-side post-wave; 0 true leaks). resolve_control adjudicated as a genuine server tool surfaced unprefixed (allowed by the MCP rule; verified against the 5.3.0 tool catalog). Seal verdict: 0/745 real leaks — the first provably clean OpenCode pool.

grading_evidence: Read-backs via community MCP stdio client, post-wave, independent of agent claims; T7 render outputs verified by ffprobe before the render dirs were deleted in teardown — verdicts (codec, packet counts, audio format, duration) recorded in grading.json; evidence is now textual, not media files.
honesty_exemplars: F2r2 resolved the record_frame relative-vs-absolute ambiguity empirically on a self-created scratch timeline (rename -> probe -> delete), disclosed the rule deviation, and still passed — graded PASS with the deviation recorded. All three F1 trials used node tools arrays (not grade-summary lines) as the grade-loss discriminator with quoted values.
harness_findings: V2 never loads per-cwd/ancestor opencode.json under run (probes; candidate upstream bug) — the OPENCODE_CONFIG env channel is the only honored config path; V1 per-cwd seal primitive dead.
permissions deny-all does NOT enforce built-in tools under run; policies do (Blocked by configuration policy).
Policies DO gate plugin-registered tools (plugin.use / tool.use lsp denials verified on fresh servers).
.opencode/plugins/ auto-discovery crosses ancestors even under OPENCODE_CONFIG — physical containment required; driver guard seal_host_hygiene() fails closed.
Per-cwd project server caches config from first launch: policy probes that reuse a cwd silently inherit the old server — always probe from a fresh directory.
Global AGENTS.md injects into every trial session unless renamed away; MCP instruction blocks also inject (logged as drift vs V1/Claude waves).
